items.title: Why Is Delta Air Lines (DAL) Fighting Heathrow’s Planned 2028 Terminal Move?

Both airlines are preparing legal and regulatory challenges to Heathrow's decision, according to their current public stance. The proposed terminal move would affect Delta's transatlantic hub operations with Virgin Atlantic at one of Europe's busiest airports.
